scope: TECT-owner input-boundary audit for one attempted finite-regulator comparison of the native Reading-H G_* branch with a preregistered physical-empty branch E. The audit freezes the requested owner-contract fields, checks the current authorities, and evaluates no energy or Hessian when a required field is absent.

owner_contract.reason: The current Reading-H source is a shell variational covariance owner without a declared physical volume, UV regulator, boundary condition, finite-part trajectory, or physical-empty normalization. The P1 finite torus owner is a different parent and has a pinned zero/disordered reference but no registered G_* image.

physical_empty_branch_E.definition: A physical-empty or empty-preparation branch in the same finite-regulator parent as G_*; its field/state representative, measure, normalization and boundary preparation are intentionally left null until an owner supplies them.
physical_empty_branch_E.why_not_zero: The existing P1 zero/disordered constrained reference is not a physical-empty branch and is not mapped to the Reading-H owner.

assumptions: The native Reading-H G_* owner and the cited R-169/R-170 boundaries are the current TECT authorities.
A valid comparison must use one parent configuration/state space and one finite-regulator normalization for both entries.
The requested sign orientation is G_* minus E, and stationarity is on the full admissible regulated tangent.
Symmetry projection removes exactly the declared symmetry/gauge orbit tangent before the transverse Hessian infimum is formed.
missing_assumptions: A hash-pinned finite-regulator F_total expression whose domain contains both G_* and E.
A physical-empty E state/configuration and its measure or algebra in that same domain.
A common normalization, finite-part counterterm basis, coefficient trajectory and renormalization conditions.
A physical volume, regulator/cutoff, boundary condition and thermodynamic-then-continuum limit order.
A deterministic representation/map for G_* in the finite parent and a deterministic representation/map for E.
A full regulated tangent, exact symmetry orbit tangent, transverse projector and Hessian form.
Stationarity residual and numerical/thermodynamic/continuum/scheme error budgets.
blockers: Reading-H B1/R-169 proves only F[Q]-F[G_*]>0 on a finite shell class and explicitly does not quantify a physical volume, UV regulator, thermodynamic or continuum limit.
R-169 v1.3 explicitly records that no sign for F_RH[G_*]-F_empty is obtained and that G_* is a covariance owner, not a BCC mean/cell owner.
The P1 zero/disordered reference belongs to a different side-16 finite parent; R-169 v1.1 provides no Reading-H G_* image or full energy/ensemble intertwiner.
A1 records an external-source-audit failure and a declared-functional versus implemented-residual mismatch, so it cannot silently serve as a repaired common parent.
Without a common parent and admitted E, the sign, full-field Reading-H stationarity and symmetry-projected transverse Hessian are undefined for this request.
evidence_level: T0 / EXECUTED INPUT-BOUNDARY AUDIT; no numerical energy, stationarity residual, or Hessian was evaluated

No mass-gap, physical-vacuum, below-empty-space, C6, Sector-A or Pre-A closure.

revisit_conditions: Supply one owner-approved hash-pinned finite-regulator parent with all eight requested comparison fields fixed before the candidates are evaluated.
Admit E with a physical interpretation, state/configuration representative, normalization, boundary preparation and exact map into that parent.
Provide G_* and E full-domain maps, full tangent and symmetry projector, then rerun unchanged primary, independent and hostile lanes with error budgets.
Only a certified uniform sign, full-tangent stationarity and positive transverse form may advance the conditional R-169 reduction; no physical or Yang-Mills promotion follows automatically.

adversarial_review.check: Treating the P1 zero/disordered reference as physical empty E without a Reading-H map is rejected.
Combining Reading-H G_* with the P1 functional merely because both mention a finite shell is rejected.
A shared scalar shift or an unspecified finite-part choice cannot supply the missing state-dependent comparison.
Covariance-owner stationarity is not silently promoted to full-field stationarity on a regulated tangent.
A projected Hessian is not formed without an exact symmetry orbit, full tangent and error budget.
The blocked input audit is not promoted to a physical vacuum, C6 or Yang-Mills mass-gap claim.

boundary: This result records a reproducible TECT-owner blocker and a symbolic preregistration slot for E. It does not evaluate F_total[G_*]-F_total[E], Reading-H full-field stationarity or symmetry-projected transverse stability.
no_overclaim: The absence of a common finite owner is an input-boundary finding in the searched authorities, not a universal nonexistence theorem. No zero-field identification, physical-empty sign, Yang-Mills result or mass gap is inferred.
